import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0147 (a b c : Nat) (h1 : a ≤ b + c) (h2 : b ≤ a + c) : a + b ≤ 2 * c + 2 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0147 (a b c : Nat) (h1 : a ≤ b + c) (h2 : b ≤ a + c) : a + b ≤ 2 * c + 2 := by
  have h3 : a + b ≤ (b + c) + (a + c) := by
    rw [add_assoc, h2]
  have h4 : (b + c) + (a + c) = a + b + 2 * c := by
    rw [add_assoc, add_comm b c, add_assoc]
  have h5 : a + b + 2 * c ≤ 2 * c + 2 := by
    rw [h3, h4]
    linarith
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0147 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0147 := by
